title: Legitimate business volume change (FR-1301 #4)
notes: A marketing campaign doubled signups. The alert fired against a stale forecast (22000); the authoritative current metric carries the campaign-adjusted expectation (40800), so the observed 41200 is within tolerance and the alert condition is absent. FR-901 stops the investigation before a single hypothesis is generated — the system declines to find a fault rather than naming the least-bad category. No specialist runs, and no operational budget is spent.
